title: CLR/15/2015 of Smt Neha Dubey AND ANOTHER Vs Swami Prakashanand Shastri AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLR NO. 15 of 2018
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Mahavir S. Tyagi, Advocate for
the revisionists.
Heard.
Issue notice to the respondents by
registered post, acknowledgment due,
returnable at an early date.
Steps to be taken within a week.
List after service report is received.
Meanwhile, further proceedings of
O.S. No. 20 of 2012 pending in the
Court of learned Civil Judge (Senior
Division), Laksar, District Haridwar
shall remain stayed.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
 05.04.2018
